Variable name(s): rh015_; rh016_; rh018_ (raw blank indicators retained)

Missingness criteria: True DK, refusal, unknown and other missing responses remain missing. A cleaned NaN alone is not structural-skip evidence.

Missingness criteria: Invalid start ages <0 or >100 are missing; unknown onset or continuity is not assigned zero.
